Priya S: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Priya S: what I did: rolled a small canary of the batcher size bump (2->4) for embed-generation route, validated perf on eu-west. noticed intermittent 5xxs in canary but only from retry storm.
Priya S: blockers: still seeing a p95 tail at ~420ms for embeddings during traffic bursts, not consistent locally. repro attempts show KV cache thrash when sequence length spikes.
Priya S: today: will dig into autoscaler cooldown + batching window; open to oncall tweak for alert window if we need breathing room.

Alex H: thanks — can you paste the alert query? want to see exact thresholds.

Priya S: sure — query I used: `sum(rate(http_latency_bucket{route="/embed"}[5m])) by (le)` then `histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)`
Priya S: alert fired when `histogram_quantile(0.95) > 300` for 3m. saw spikes at 420 for ~4m.

DevOps Bot: new alert ticket created: #ENGSRE-1248 — "embed p95 spike during burst" — assigned to oncall. Link: https://tracker/redwood/ticket/ENGSRE-1248

Samir: oncall pinged — I'm taking ownership for the next 2h window. quick plan: (1) confirm if kv-cache eviction counts jump, (2) temporarily raise p95 alert to 450ms if we see more noisy flaps, (3) collect flamegraph for batcher process.

Toni: +1 on data collection. Priya — if you can narrow repro steps or attach sample trace IDs that would speed it up.

Priya S: will add traces. I also noticed autoscaler cooldown is 60s which might be too short for bursty traffic; will prototype 120s on a canary.

Alex H: FYI — if we change alert window to 5m during investigation we avoid noisy pagers. keep me posted before you flip it. :eyes:

Samir: will coordinate with oncall to update the alert policy and revert after metrics stabilize. posting a short runbook in #incidents after we confirm steps.

Toni: any ETA on the flamegraph?

Samir: 45-60m if the profiler capture goes cleanly.

Priya S: thanks team — will post findings and trace IDs here when ready.

Alex H: thanks — if it looks like a config regression we'll circle back on release history for the batcher.

DevOps Bot: reminder: weekly SLO review is tomorrow at 10:00 PT. add anything you want on the agenda to the doc: https://docs/redwood/slo/review

Priya S: noted, adding a short note about embed tail risk.

Toni: ack.
